71' 1 - 1 Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.

71' A sweet pass finds Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball low towards the middle of the goal. Sergio Herrera is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.

70' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Lucas Torro (Osasuna). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the right post and is cleared to safety. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.

59' Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.

45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Great chance! Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) picks up a rebound inside the box, cuts inside his marker but rifles his shot well wide of the right post.
44' The ball is laid off to Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom left corner and forces Sergio Herrera to make a decent save.
43' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
42' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
41' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
41' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
40' Now Ath Bilbao have a corner.
40' Ath Bilbao seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

39' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
38' Ath Bilbao quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

38' What a sweet touch by Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) as he runs onto a pass deep into the box and fires a fine shot to the right side of the net. The keeper makes a superb save and pushes the ball against the post. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Ath Bilbao.

34' 1 - 0 Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) unleashes a beautiful rocket of a shot from a long-range free kick. The ball goes into the top of the net and leaves the goalkeeper beaten. This takes hours and hours on the training ground. The score is 1:0.
34' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for holding. Jose Munuera signals a set piece. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Osasuna.
33' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
32' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
31' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
30' Good work from Ath Bilbao as they win a corner.
30' The free kick is delivered by Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. Ath Bilbao force their opponents to concede a corner.
29' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) was too forceful with his tackle and Jose Munuera interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a free kick.
27' A player from Ath Bilbao commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Osasuna, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
26' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Jon Moncayola (Osasuna). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
25' Jose Munuera interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao). Osasuna have a free kick.
23' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
22' Osasuna have a corner.
21' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
19' Unai Simon pulls off a great save to deny Jon Moncayola (Osasuna), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.

17' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
17' Ath Bilbao fail to score from a corner as Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) leaps to collect the ball.
17' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao). Ath Bilbao get a corner.
15' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) is caught offside!

13' A clever short pass gives Ante Budimir (Osasuna) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
12' The Osasuna players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
11' Javi Galan (Osasuna) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Ath Bilbao have a free kick.
10' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
9' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jose Munuera ignores the protests.

7' Ath Bilbao win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal. Javi Galan (Osasuna) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jose Munuera blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
4' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
2' A pass by Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.

2' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Unai Simon pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
